reviews.title: Excellent case for larger PC builds !!
reviews.comment:
I purchased the NZXT H9 Flow RGB Case as the start of my brand new high-end PC build that I had been planning for months, and I couldn't have been any happier with the ending result.
First, the case came packaged very well and there was nothing broken upon arrival.
Next, the overall experience I had building my brand new computer in this build was amazing. The spacious, premium design to the case gives it a lot of flexibility with whatever type of build you want to do.
The thumbscrews to remove the panels is a great gesture and definitely makes it easy to remove/apply the side or back panel when needed. Speaking on the back side of the case, it was very shocking seeing how much space this case has to cable manage and store extra cables in the back. It fits very well with a modular PSU allowing for usage of additional USB Hubs also purchased from NZXT.
I am very satisfied with the build quality and features of this Case, would recommend if its not too big for your liking !
reviews.author: Sam Hollister

reviews.title: Amazing Case
reviews.comment:
This case is GREAT!  Seen a lot of video hype over it so I just figured I'd give it a try.  Its a breeze to build in, wire management points are plenty and cut outs in the case are very well placed.  AIO and fan support are A+, and the case is made very well.
I do wish it was easier to take the front glass panel off, its pretty difficult to pop off.  The included 140mm fans are plenty loud at full speed, but I supposed that is expected for included fans.  There really are no major complaints, airflow is great, design is great, build quality is great, and the build experience was excellent.
reviews.author: Bill W

reviews.title: This is Nice!!
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1mIxC+oDpL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/81wkO0ywMrL._SY256.jpg A lot of space . Easy cable management . Easy 420mm radiator install at the top. I got the RGB version not the plus, so it came with with 420mm rgb core that you can use with NZXT hub or connect it to your own RGB hub as it has those options on the wiring from the fan. I was iffy on the black on white but I I like it. This was my first time messing with PC parts or moving cases it felt easy with this case, I just labeled stuff with painters tape and took pictures, easy peasy.

reviews.title: Great case to build in
reviews.comment: I chose this specific case for the ability to put 9x 420mm fans in it. Airflow is amazing and it was great to build in. Plenty of space for an E-ATX as I put the new glacial board in it with a 9950X3D. The front hub is good but it’s the glass that I love
